change.description: Preserve the managed task timeline SSE v1 contract and add opt-in marker-only SSE v2 with fixed-watermark HTTP pages and afterRevision deltas.
change.release_unit_description: Managed task timeline API with compatible SSE v1 and additive SSE v2, including fixed-watermark HTTP paging and revision catch-up.

planned.reasoning: The existing unversioned timeline SSE v1 interval snapshot/delta contract remains available. Marker-only v2 is selected through the additive schemaVersion parameter, while the built-in page opts into HTTP pagination. The persisted timeline schema and existing task controls, colors, request timestamps, and duration semantics are unchanged.

scope_drift.description: The owner rejected a major release. Compatibility was restored by preserving the unversioned v1 interval contract and making marker-only v2 opt-in through an additive schemaVersion parameter.

current.reasoning: The timeline SSE v1 contract remains unchanged for existing consumers. The new v2 marker-only contract is opt-in, so the public API change is additive. The maintenance-store schema, control columns, and legacy history semantics are unchanged by this transport change.

verified.reasoning: The unversioned v1 snapshot/delta transport remains available with its existing 10,000-segment bound; the marker-only v2 transport is explicitly selected by schemaVersion=2. Rust topic-contract and transport regressions plus frontend synchronization tests cover both contracts. The isolated service loaded all 13,120 fixture intervals in 27 fixed-watermark pages and applied the concurrent revision once; reconnect restored the persisted watermark. Browser integration rendered all 13,120 fixture IDs without an unavailable warning. Persistent-state impact remains minor, so the release unit maximum is minor.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Consumers that omit schemaVersion continue receiving the existing system.managed-tasks.timeline/v1 interval snapshot/delta contract. Consumers that need unbounded timeline history may opt into schemaVersion=2 and load interval rows through the paginated HTTP timeline endpoint; workload response fields and enabled-only task updates remain compatible additions.

persistent_state.state_description: Existing maintenance controls and task-run history plus stable colors, actual execution boundaries, task-deferral intervals, observation sessions, coverage revisions, and bounded per-task workload samples.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: The candidate reads supported earlier-minor maintenance databases with the task tables; older minors need not read the new workload table, and direct major skips remain unsupported. Persistent-state impact is minor.

calculation_evidence: verified public_api=minor (v1 retained; v2 is opt-in)
